definitions.gloss: short essay; essay (for exams or applications)
definitions.explanation: A brief essay, typically written as part of university entrance exams or job applications in Japan. Usually requires the writer to present and argue a position on a given topic.

examples.japanese: ⟦{入試|にゅうし}→入試：04705_nyuushi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{小論文|しょうろんぶん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I'm preparing for the essay portion of the entrance exam.

examples.japanese: {小論文|しょうろんぶん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{八百字|はっぴゃくじ}⟦{以内|いない}→以内：01317_inai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{書|か}いて→書く：00477_kaku⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please write the essay in 800 characters or less.

examples.japanese: {小論文|しょうろんぶん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{論理的|ろんりてき}→論理的：05672_ronriteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{述|の}べる→述べる：02389_noberu⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{求|もと}められる→求める：02316_motomeru⟧。
examples.english: In an essay exam, you are required to state your opinion logically.

notes:
USAGE:
A key component of many Japanese university entrance exams and job applications. Unlike ⟦{作文|さくぶん}→作文：02884_sakubun⟧ (composition), which is more open-ended and personal, {小論文|しょうろんぶん} requires a structured argument with a clear thesis. Typical length is 600-800 characters.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {小論文|しょうろんぶん}⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧ (essay exam preparation)
- {小論文|しょうろんぶん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧ (to write an essay)
- {小論文|しょうろんぶん}⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧ (essay exam)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{作文|さくぶん}→作文：02884_sakubun⟧: composition (less formal, more creative)
- ⟦{論文|ろんぶん}→論文：03787_ronbun⟧: thesis, academic paper (longer, more rigorous)
- ⟦レポート→レポート：01543_repooto⟧: report (academic assignment)
